note: Historical draft calendar, one row per phase with selections in MLB's feed. A day is given only when a source states it; otherwise the month comes from MLB's phase name ("January Amateur Draft", "June Secondary Draft", "August Legion Draft") and start_date_precision is MONTH. Rounds are filled from MLB's feed when the row is added. Years not listed here are not on the calendar yet (docs/history/backfill-plan.md).

wikipedia-1965.title: Wikipedia: 1965 Major League Baseball draft (revision 1358425090)
wikipedia-1965.notes: "It was held on June 8-9 in New York City." Also states "A total of 813 players were selected", which MLB's feed (824 picks, 821 people) does not match: recorded as a census disagreement, not resolved. CC BY-SA 4.0; facts only.

wikipedia-1985.title: Wikipedia: 1985 Major League Baseball draft (revision 1337668239)
wikipedia-1985.notes: "The 1985 Major League Baseball draft took place in June 1985." No day and no total stated. CC BY-SA 4.0; facts only.

wikipedia-2005.title: Wikipedia: 2005 Major League Baseball draft (revision 1345402014)
wikipedia-2005.notes: "The 2005 Major League Baseball draft, was held on June 7 and 8." CC BY-SA 4.0; facts only.

mlb-draft-types.title: MLB Stats API draft types
mlb-draft-types.notes: Phase names: Rule 4 / June Amateur Draft (JR), January Amateur Draft (NR), January Secondary Draft (NS), June Secondary Draft (JS), June Secondary (Delayed) (JD), August Legion Draft (AL). A phase's month is taken from its name when no day is published.
